samples.label: sample-01
samples.evidence: Third-person view clearly shows the player, coin trail, raised green platforms, hazards, readable objective HUD, and jump/dash prompts.

samples.label: sample-04
samples.evidence: The initial view clearly presents a coin line, distant goal, raised platforms, hazard, readable objective and count, movement/jump prompts, and restart input.

comparisonVerdict.rationale: It communicates the complete playable loop most clearly in one initial view: objective, collectible route, goal, hazard, platforms, input prompts, and restart path.
